description: x402 catalog report + time series — the current graded census of the CDP Bazaar index AND the diff against every previous sweep we hold, so a directory can see what moved instead of guessing. Per-host rows (grade, score, live-402 count, named defect ids, latency, audited_at) plus sweep-by-sweep deltas: grade changes, new and cleared defects, hosts that stopped answering. Depth is stated in the payload (`sweeps`) rather than promised: we sell the history we have measured, neve
name: akari_catalog_report_history
